retrievalProfile.description: A dynamic fitness-themed layout featuring a runner in motion against a blurred natural background with layered, clean sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A bright, energetic composition featuring a female runner from a rear three-quarter view, positioned on the left, with large-scale typography occupying the upper right quadrant against a soft-focus beach horizon.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject motion directed toward the right typographic block
High-key natural lighting contrasting with solid text colors
Horizontal horizon line bisecting the subject's torso
Typographic hierarchy moving from large display to small metadata
coreInvariants: Blurred coastal background with distinct sand and water zones
Subject in active running pose with visible muscle definition
Clean, geometric sans-serif typeface for primary titles

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body runner positioned on the left third, scaled to occupy the vertical height of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large display text in the upper right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the runner's head, follows the direction of motion to the large title, then down to the secondary text blocks.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open sky and blurred ocean provide breathing room for the text on the right.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted blues and greys of the beach background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White for primary and secondary text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange/coral of the runner's shorts.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, low-saturation background allows high-contrast white text to pop.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for body text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold condensed display paired with light-weight geometric body text.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule or implied line separating text blocks

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, modern, and compact look of the display text.
Provides the geometric clarity needed for the secondary information.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key photograph of a person running on a beach, viewed from behind at a slight angle, with a shallow depth of field blurring the ocean and sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned sans-serif text in the upper right quadrant, using a bold condensed font for the main title and a light-weight font for the subtitle and list.

verificationChecks: Is the runner positioned on the left side?
Is the background sufficiently blurred to ensure text legibility?

mustRedesign: Specific song titles in the tracklist

mustAchieve: Clear legibility of all text elements

postGenerationChecks: Check that the horizon line is straight.
Ensure the runner's pose looks natural and active.
Verify that the text does not touch the edges of the frame.
Confirm the color of the shorts provides a distinct focal point.
recipe.reuseFormula: Active subject on left + blurred natural background + right-aligned sans-serif typography hierarchy.
